description: This is a Java source file defining an abstract class PriorityPreset, which serves as a base for notification priority presets within an Android application supporting wearable notifications.

classes.name: PriorityPreset
classes.description: An abstract class providing a template for notification priority presets, extending NamedPreset and defining an abstract method to apply priority settings to notifications.

methods.name: PriorityPreset
methods.description: Constructor accepting a resource ID for the name, passing it to the superclass NamedPreset.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Abstract method to apply priority configurations to a NotificationCompat.Builder and its wearable options.
